prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='NaiveSeasonal', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: NaiveSeasonal perfectly captures trend (corr=1.0) while ONLY_DWT_rf leads seasonality (corr=0.807), but FT_catboost achieves lowest RMSE (99.61). Extreme model disagreement (RMSE spread=80.18) and high seasonality variance (0.826) indicate models capture different signal components. STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit this decomposition-aware structure while mitigating disagreement through component-wise combination.
